components.World: physical entities only; no target or task
components.ArtificialBody: an Entity with motor and proprioceptive state
components.Neuron: persistent activity, threshold and modulation receptors
components.Path: fixed/plastic propagation relation with multi-dimensional state
components.PredictionRegion: future activity tendency, not explicit answer
components.ArtificialDNA: birth formation rules and organ structure
components.Sleep: 0.5 internal propagation then Plastic Path settlement
components.Observer: read-only per-Signal, per-Neuron and per-Path traces
components.Console: observe and switch Teaching/Sleep phases; no structure editing
